question: Can a script-contrastive evidence lattice turn official English, Traditional-Chinese, and public-mark metadata into a high-precision named-place proof on fresh bilingual signage, while keeping unreadable views UNKNOWN and preserving the appearance fallback?

frozen_scope.development: Four entities and eight queries: one human-labeled identity-bearing view and one context view per entity.
frozen_scope.test: Four different entities and eight queries with the same source-only strata.
frozen_scope.prior_exclusion: All eight entities are absent from the PB1, PB2-A, and PB3 formal cohorts; Hong Kong Heritage Museum was removed because it appeared in the earlier PB2-A human rejection audit.
frozen_scope.negative_boundary: Pairwise wrong-request rows are source-label negatives only; exhaustive physical absence of every other entity is not claimed.
frozen_scope.portal_boundary: No portal proposal, portal ownership, COMMIT, tracking, active observation, navigation, or arrival decision is invoked.

arms.B0_APPEARANCE: Development selects CLIP, DINOv2, or fixed z-scored CLIP+DINO by the frozen PB2-A selection order. The balanced-accuracy acceptance threshold is Development-only.
arms.C0_ENGLISH_CANONICAL: SequenceMatcher over the canonical English name and OCR line/contiguous-line windows; no Chinese alias or mark is visible to this control.
arms.C1_FLAT_BISCRIPT_ALIAS: Take the maximum SequenceMatcher score over frozen English aliases, Han aliases after a fixed traditional/simplified fold, and public marks. There is no atom weighting, agreement bonus, or conflict veto.
arms.C2_SCIL: Script-Contrastive Identity Lattice. English word atoms, Han unigrams/bigrams after a fixed traditional/simplified fold, and exact public-mark atoms receive split-local inverse-document-frequency weights computed from the frozen candidate metadata only. Each carrier mixes SequenceMatcher and weighted atom recall at 0.45/0.55; the entity score is its strongest carrier plus 0.10 of the second. If independently strong carriers (>=0.72) name different entities, all entity scores become zero and the frame remains UNKNOWN.
arms.C3_ASYMMETRIC_JOIN: A C2 proof authorizes only that requested entity and vetoes other requested entities. C2 UNKNOWN preserves B0 instead of becoming NONE, so missing text cannot erase a target-present appearance decision.

development_selection.appearance: Select arm and acceptance threshold on Development only.
development_selection.text: For C0, C1, and C2 independently, enumerate observed top-score and top1-minus-top2 midpoint thresholds plus 0 and 1; maximize proof precision, then correct-proof coverage, then identity-bearing coverage, then the stricter thresholds.
development_selection.test_seal: Test OCR, carrier scores, labels, and outcomes are not inspected until every appearance and text choice is fixed by Development.

metrics: appearance Recall@1, Recall@3, positive acceptance, and source-label-negative false confirmation
C0/C1/C2 proof precision, correct-proof coverage, identity-bearing/context coverage, wrong proofs, and UNKNOWN
C2 carrier conflicts, multi-script proofs, and correct proofs with Han or mark participation
C3 positive acceptance and false-confirmation reduction versus B0

promotion_gate.proof_precision: C2 test proof precision must be at least 0.95 with zero wrong-entity proofs.
promotion_gate.identity_bearing_coverage: C2 must correctly prove at least 3/4 test identity-bearing queries.
promotion_gate.positive_guardrail: C3 test positive acceptance must be no lower than B0.
promotion_gate.false_confirmation_effect: C3 must reduce B0 source-label-negative false confirmations by at least 50% relative or 0.10 absolute.
promotion_gate.flat_alias_pareto: C2 must have at least as many correct proofs and no more wrong proofs than C1 on test.
promotion_gate.script_utility: At least one correct C2 test proof must have Han or public-mark carrier score >=0.45.
promotion_gate.decision: All six clauses are required for L10_PB4_SCRIPT_CONTRASTIVE_IDENTITY_LATTICE_GATE_MET.

successor.gate_met: Retain C2 as a conditional positive identity authority. The next experiment may join only C2-proved current images to a separately frozen functional portal set; UNKNOWN continues to request APPROACH_TEXT or SWEEP_SIGN.
successor.gate_not_met: Close this single-frame bilingual representation. Change to external localization, a separately observed logo reference, or execution-receipt-backed active observation; do not tune aliases, folds, atom weights, thresholds, OCR models, or pixels on the opened cohort.

claim_boundary: Fresh entity-disjoint public-image evidence for conditional bilingual signage identity only. The cohort is deliberately identity-opportunity stratified and is not natural encounter prevalence. Wrong-request pairs are source-label proxies. No open-world identity, portal ownership, access, active-view causality, tracking, navigation, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety claim follows.
